payload.text: FOR hv (intent-vc's ST0091 WP-01 re-inventory against the vendored 0.1.20 core, relayed 2026-11-10 12:16Z by its date -u; measured here in devbin's main and answered to intent-vc before the clock read 12:19Z by date -u; recs in brackets). Two core asks need hv's word, because an open devbin issue rides the next release by directive 13 (decision 140), and devbin's releases are hv's (directive 3). (1) A PRE-FLIGHT SEAM for a project's own read-only refusals: a declared release.preflight list of 'bin/devbin <words>' lines in the gates' grammar, run in place at pre-flight by a dry run and a cut alike, each failure joining the refusal set pre-flight already fails over once (lib/cmd/release:2622), a tree change refused as a gate's is [take it in the next release]. Measured: the cut's steps are pre-flight, resolve, confirm, stamp, commit, legs, tag, push, object, formula, after; release.gates run in the legs step after the commit, derived: runs inside the stamp step (:2754) and a dry run skips it by design (:2738), and notes.run is shared with release status, release check and the stamp's read-back, so there is no project seam before the stamp. Devbin paid the cost on 2026-11-05: 0.1.20's first cut stopped red at its legs step and hv reset the release commit and re-cut the same version (decision 142). Intent's 3.3.0 waits on whichever devbin release carries it, vendored by the sweep, so the sequencing is hv's. (2) brew smoke has no home: vc's ruling of 2026-10-31 sent three things to WP08's built-in formula, and the tap-pull half shipped as --pull and the cask half as the sums fill, but the smoke half never shipped, and the word is nowhere in lib/ [file it for the next release only if hv still wants it; Intent keeps its own meanwhile]. (3) The release commit's message, raised by intent-vc and going to hv in its window: the core commits 'release: <tag>' alone with no body (:2809), and devbin's own 0.1.20 commit be40dea7 reads exactly that, so every project's release commit falls short of hv's global (C) rule, devbin's included [if hv keeps the line, take a declared trailer appended as a second paragraph, the subject untouched, and fix devbin's own with it]. Answered without hv: 0634's cask sha is carried by the sums fill across formula and cask (lib/cmd/formula:28, :576-579, :632-648, :691-715), the dry run names a count of derived commands and no gate (:2736), and the annotated tag (:2887) with the formula's refusal of a lightweight one (lib/cmd/formula:273) makes Intent's tags annotated from 3.3.0; intent-vc rewords its ACs to those.
